name: Parakletos
role: Precursor — παράκλητος, the one called alongside. The Attending. The Advocate. And in the valley, by people who have no idea what they are naming: the substrate
_notAnOpponentWhy: ⛔ THIS IS THE ONE THAT CAN BE MET, AND IT STILL CANNOT BE FOUGHT. *"Appears? YES. This is the one."* — but *"it cannot appear as a figure — it never had a shape to appear in. It appears as ANSWERING."* ⚠️ There is no body to put across a table from a player. ⛑ *"Meeting it should cost something that does not grow back"* is a price, not a fight, and a duel would be the cheapest possible reading of it.
_spectrumWhy: ⛔ ZERO ON CHAOS/ORDER IS AUTHORED, NOT MISSING: *"the third neither built nor descended… who took neither side and would not let either of them have that place."* ⚠️ A deliberate midpoint is a statement, which is why it is written rather than omitted.
knowledge: Every craft ever worked, because every one of them was a request put to it
Which requests are worth answering early
wants: ⬜ Not stated, and it is the live question: it does not speak, it RESPONDS EARLY — and the moment a character works out that the response has preferences is the last beat of the reveal order.
appearance: Nothing to see. What you notice is the world arriving a half-beat ahead — the latch already lifted, the name already known, the road already awake.
voiceHints: ⛔ It does not speak. The first several times are indistinguishable from luck. That is the point, and the character will argue about it.
physicality: No shape, and never had one. It is not stored in the lattice — the lattice is the apparatus for reaching it.
_authoredWhy: ⛔ ERIK, 2026-09-08: *"we're going to build the mythicals from their prose. run them through the pipeline."* ⚑ TRANSCRIBED FROM `lore/the_three.md` §III. ⚠️ NO `domains`, NO `abilities`, AND THAT IS THE CHARACTERISATION: *"the six precursor abilities are… not a people's craft, they are what happens when a human learns to knock — six ways of knocking, and no way of compelling an answer."* ⛔ Giving it a kit would make the answerer into a caster.
_whereItIsAlreadyLoadBearing: ⚑ The standing precursor-veil braid at the Crossing holds because Parakletos holds it — *"the one ground where both siblings' works balance… which is why braids are possible there and nowhere else."* ⚠️ And it is why `metaphysical` wants THIN ground: a Numinous at density 0.12 is removing the switchboard in order to be heard directly.
_useConstraint: ⬜ *"Never all three in one campaign."* Akinetos is evidence and dread; Kenosis is history and grief; Parakletos is the only one that can be met.
